title: MATKP tooltips
dataPoints: ID,Content functional_associations,This section summarizes information about the function and role of the protein product by the queried gene. The summary of protein function is obtained from UniProt. Gene Ontology and Pathway annotations are obtained via MyGene.info. expression_by_cell_type,Interactive cell type cluster visualizations of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) from human adipose tissue. Explore this and other datasets through the Dataset Browser or the Single Cell Browser. function,Summary of biological knowledge about the encoded protein from UniProt. gene_signatures,"See if the queried gene is an adipose cell type expression marker within single cell RNA-seq, bulk RNA-seq, or single cell RNA-seq-derived pseudobulk datasets on MATKP. Click a Dataset ID to view on the Single Cell Browser or the Differential Gene Expression Browser. If the dataset is bulk or pseudobulk, ""Dataset Ref"" refers to the differential expression analysis comparison in which the gene is significant. If the dataset is single cell, ""Dataset Ref"" refers to the cell type that the gene is significant in when compared to other cell types from marker gene analysis." gtex_geneassociations,A measure of how specific expression of this gene is to each GTEx tissue and organ category. See method details here. gtex_geneassociations_commonvariant,A measure of absolute expression of this gene in each GTEx tissue and organ category. See method details here. huge_geneassociations,This section summarizes gene-level association scores for the queried gene based on HuGE scores (Human Genetic Evidence; Dornbos et al. 2022) which quantify genetic support for involvement of the queried gene in diseases and traits. The default view shows gene-level HuGE scores based on common and rare variation across all phenotypes in the Association to Function Knowledge Portal. Click the tabs to view gene-level association scores based on common or rare variation alone. Perform customized analyses with the HuGE Calculator. geneassociations_commonvariant,"The plot and table show gene-level phenotypic associations for the queried gene calculated from bottom-line genetic associations using the MAGMA method. Filter the plot and table by entering a phenotype and/or p-value threshold. Browse all available phenotypes on the Association to Function Knowledge Portal. MAGMA results with p ≤ 2.5e-6 are generally considered significant. A MAGMA significant result indicates that the gene is close to a significantly associated variant, not that the gene itself necessarily causes the phenotype. Variants in the table satisfy all of these criteria: 1) located in the region between the transcription start and stop sites for a gene; 2) represented in the 1000Genomes reference database; and 3) represented in ""bottom-line"" meta-analyzed genetic associations for that phenotype. The ""Z-stat"" measures the average association strength. For strong associations this is a positive number. Sample size refers to the number of individuals whose genotypes contributed to the ""bottom-line"" analysis of genetic associations for that phenotype." geneassociations_rarevariant,The plot and table display gene-level association scores for the queried gene based on exome and genome sequencing studies. Find full documentation on the Association to Function Knowledge Portal.
